sloka: न ह्यदत्ताम् महीम् पित्रा भरतः शास्तुमर्हति ।त्वयि वा पुत्रवद्वस्तुम् यदि जातो महीपतेः ॥२-३७-३०॥
transliteration: na hyadattām mahīm pitrā bharataḥ śāstumarhati ।tvayi vā putravadvastum yadi jāto mahīpateḥ ॥2-37-30॥

translations.english: If Bharata is truly born to the king, he will not rule the kingdom which has not been bestowed on him (wholeheartedly) by his father. Nor will he live like a son to you.
